svg.title: Lem
svg.desc: A tall hooded coat stands in a cut field and holds one long line in both hands. One small red eye glows in its hood. Strands hang from the line to four smaller hooded figures and to the word Lem, set in pixel letters with a block cursor. A pulse of light runs along the line, each peg flashes as it passes, and the tiles of the word light one by one. By day a low sun sends haze and soft rays over the field; at night stars blink and pale bands of light drift across the sky.
